decisions.decision: User confirmed at the design gate: four nullable DOUBLE PRECISION TPMS columns with no DEFAULT, no new index, and the cross-schema backfill UPDATE joining on vm.metric_date = vs.captured_date - 1. Down migration drops the columns only.
decisions.why: Shown the full schema, the projected-only index analysis, and the silent-NULL risk on unmatched rows. Confirmed all three without change.

decisions.decision: Reorder migrationDirs in internal/analytics/testdb_test.go so analytics applies LAST, matching the Makefile's MIGRATIONS_DIRS. The migration SQL confirmed at D-GATE-1 is unchanged.
decisions.why: The rejected alternative, a to_regclass guard, makes the suite pass by making the backfill silently do nothing. That deletes the only signal that apply order is wrong.

decisions.decision: Leader overrode the worker on task 3.3 and edited kkpa/context/use-case/gateway/read-dashboard-bento.md. Its 'Nine of VehicleStatus's fields are pointers' sentence now names what the mapper reads, and points at analytics.go for the real field list.
decisions.why: The sentence stated a property of the type, not of the mapper. VehicleStatus now holds 15 pointers, so an agent trusting the KB would conclude the TPMS fields do not exist.

events.detail: Tier 1 artifacts written by the analytics worker (Sonnet) and validated with openspec validate --strict: valid. Design gate opened and CONFIRMED by the user (D-GATE-1). Pipeline halts here per the kkpa-pickup-linear-ticket scope: no implementation workers dispatched.

Wave 1 dispatched to the analytics worker (Sonnet), serial single dispatch: tasks 1.1-1.6 and 2.1-2.4 (schema, sqlc regen, Go mapping, offline unit test). Budget at dispatch: five_hour 41%, context 9%, cost $0.645.

Wave 1 done. Worker reported all 10 tasks complete; leader set them awaiting-user-verification because the offline unit tests were written but not run. Leader fix: make migration-guard found version 20260908000001 already used by internal/account, so the migration was renumbered to 20260908000002 and the filename updated in design.md and tasks.md. Clean: go build, go vet, gofmt -l internal/analytics, make migration-guard, make boundary-guard, make tz-guard. Worker report enumerated D1, D2, D3 and RD2 with compliance statements; leader cross-checked D2 in consumed.go (both branches) and D3 (no index anywhere).

The OWNER ran go test ./internal/analytics/... and reported a FAILURE: provision failed with relation "telemetry.vehicle_snapshots" does not exist (SQLSTATE 42P01) at migration 20260908000002. Root cause: internal/analytics/testdb_test.go applied its own db/migrations before telemetry's, the opposite of Makefile MIGRATIONS_DIRS. Production was never affected. Leader fixed the order (D4) and recorded the correction in design.md. Tasks stay awaiting-user-verification until the owner re-runs.

The OWNER re-ran the suite after the D4 fix and reported: 'make test passed'. Verification is the owner's, not the assistant's. Wave 1 tasks 1.1-1.6 and 2.1-2.4 move from awaiting-user-verification to done.

Wave 2 dispatched to the analytics worker (Sonnet), serial single dispatch: DB-integration tests 1.7, 1.8, 2.5 and the docs sweep 3.1, 3.2, 3.3. Budget at dispatch: five_hour 55%, context 16%, cost $7.06.

Wave 2 done. Tests 1.7/1.8/2.5 written but not run, so they are awaiting-user-verification. Docs 3.1/3.2/3.3 done. Leader correction on 3.3 (D5). Clean: go build, go vet, gofmt, migration-guard, boundary-guard, tz-guard, archive-guard. Worker enumerated D1, D2, D3 and Part C with compliance statements, and implemented every design.md Test Contract case with no skips. It substituted exact binary fractions for the contract's decimal values because telemetry.vehicle_snapshots stores TPMS as REAL (float4); the assertions are unchanged, only the input numbers.
